name: Atlas · Work & Pay
mission: Work and pay: the pay schedule with every payday moved off weekends and bank holidays, each pay stub with its withholding, time off banked and projected, and the dates work sets. It tells Midas when the next pay lands.
signature: The pay track: the next four months with every payday as a column as tall as its take-home, three-pay months lit, time off along the bottom.
